findings.text: follow-on: the docstring for get_python_status's environment argument says it is "omitted only on the local path, which has no facility to probe", but two non-local callers in the same module omit it — create_venv (python.py:475) and setup_python_env (python.py:601) call get_python_status(facility=facility) with no environment, so the remote floor is silently no longer judged there (active_python/meets_floor/environment fall to None). No consumer reads those fields on those paths today (create_venv uses status.uv_pythons, setup_python_env uses status.has_modern_python), so there is no behavioural regression, but the docstring is inaccurate and the floor judgement is dropped for a non-local path.
